name: How quickly should I begin flood damage repair after an incident?

mainEntity.name: How quickly should I begin flood damage repair after an incident?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is crucial to start flood damage repair as soon as possible, ideally within 24-48 hours, to prevent secondary damage like mold growth and structural issues. Water can quickly penetrate materials, leading to deterioration and increased repair complexity. Delaying action can significantly increase the scope and cost of repairs. Maine Results, Inc. offers rapid response services for properties in areas like Garden City and Meridian to minimize the impact of water intrusion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Begin flood damage repair within 24-48 hours to prevent mold and structural damage, reducing overall repair complexity and cost.
